description: This plot illustrates an ablation study of the recent sequence ratio, representing Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio alongside full cache reference values. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale with plotted data ranging from 10 to 100, displaying numeric tick labels from 20 to 100 at regular intervals of 20. The plot utilizes dual y-axes: the primary y-axis on the left is labeled "Perplexity" on a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, while the secondary y-axis on the right is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 10. Four lines are displayed. The "Perplexity" series, plotted against the left y-axis, is a solid orange line with circular markers; it starts at a peak value of approximately 4.59 at x=10, declines steadily to 4.30 at x=40, fluctuates with a local high of roughly 4.34 at x=60 and a local low of 4.29 at x=70, and rises to conclude at 4.38 at x=100. The "Full Cache PPL" series is a dashed dark red line without markers, also plotted on the left y-axis, which maintains a constant horizontal trend at approximately 4.38 across the entire x-axis. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" series, plotted against the right y-axis, is a solid blue line with circular markers that begins at a value of 40 at x=10, increases gradually to approximately 55 at x=80, and then rises sharply to end at a peak of 100 at x=100. Finally, the "Full Cache GPU Mem." series is a dashed blue line without markers plotted on the right y-axis, remaining perfectly steady at a constant value of 100 across the entire plotted x-axis range.
